plain_language_finding: The hybrid quantum bottleneck underperforms the classical linear head: AUC 0.699 ± 0.000 vs. 0.714 ± 0.358 (Δ=-0.015, p-value N/A (single run; multi-seed required)). The difference is not statistically significant and should not be reported as a definitive quantum advantage. Both variants demonstrate that tabular-only distillation can recover meaningful diagnostic signal from the Teacher image encoder.
